name: Fudge It! Choco Brownie
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Refined Palmolein Oil, Egg, Milk Choco Chips (8%) (Sugar, Vanaspati, Milk Solids, Cocoa Solids, Hydrogenated Vegetable Fat, Emulsifier [322(i)], Nature Identical Flavouring Substances), Cocoa Solids (3.5%), Hydrogenated Vegetable Fat, High Maltose Syrup, Liquid Glucose, Emulsifiers [471, 491, 322(i)], Iodized Salt, Artificial (Chocolate, Vanilla) and Natural Flavouring Substances, Colour [150d], Preservatives [202, 282], Stabilizer [415], Acidity Regulator [330], Baking Powder and Dextrose. Contains Wheat, Egg, Milk and Soy.
